description: Create the top tier of a Reddit ad — the campaign, which sets the OBJECTIVE everything under it optimises toward and (optionally) a lifetime spend cap. ALWAYS created PAUSED, with no override; it spends nothing until set_reddit_ads_status(confirm:true). Pick the objective deliberately, because the ad group’s bid type has to match it and it cannot be changed afterwards: CLICKS is Reddit’s name for traffic to a website (there is no TRAFFIC), CONVERSIONS optimises toward pixel events and needs a working pixel, LEAD_GENERATION optimises toward LEAD / SIGN_UP pixel events (Reddit retired onsite lead forms), IMPRESSIONS and VIDEO_VIEWABLE_IMPRESSIONS buy reach, APP_INSTALLS and CATALOG_SALES are for apps and product feeds. Reddit’s NEW names (since 2026-09-21) are accepted too: BRAND_AWARENESS (= IMPRESSIONS / VIDEO_VIEWABLE_IMPRESSIONS) and SALES (= CONVERSIONS, or CATALOG_SALES when useCatalog is true); Reddit rolls them out per account, so an account without them yet answers with Reddit’s own refusal — use the legacy name then. A campaign on its own can never serve: create an ad group under it, then an ad pointing at a post. The result is read back from Reddit.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_…) — omit when only one is shared

appId.description: APP_INSTALLS only: the App Store id (e.g. 1064216828) or Google Play package (e.g. com.reddit.frontpage)

bidAmount.description: CBO only: target cost in the ad account’s currency — required for TARGET_CPX; when set here no ad group may set its own

bidType.description: CBO only, must fit the objective — CLICKS takes CPC

budget.description: CBO only: the campaign budget in the ad account’s currency, paired with goalType

conversionPixelId.description: CBO only: needed when the ad account has more than one pixel

endTime.description: CBO only: ISO 8601, required for LIFETIME_SPEND

fundingInstrumentId.description: bill this campaign to a specific Reddit funding instrument

goalType.description: CBO only, default DAILY_SPEND; LIFETIME_SPEND needs endTime

invoiceLabel.description: agency reconciliation label on the invoice, ≤80 characters — Reddit ignores it on credit-card-funded campaigns, and the reply says so

isCampaignBudgetOptimization.description: CAMPAIGN BUDGET OPTIMIZATION (Reddit’s recommended structure): the budget and bidding live on the campaign and Reddit spreads the budget across its ad groups, which then inherit goal type, bid type and bid strategy. Needs budget, startTime, bidStrategy, bidType (and optimizationGoal on a CONVERSIONS / SALES / VIDEO_VIEWABLE_IMPRESSIONS campaign); a conversion pixel is attached automatically when the account has one. Cannot be changed after the campaign is created

objective.description: default CLICKS — which is what Reddit calls website traffic

optimizationGoal.description: CBO only: e.g. PURCHASE, SIGN_UP, LEAD, ADD_TO_CART, PAGE_VISIT, CLICKS. Cannot be changed later

schedule.description: CBO only: weekly delivery windows (day 0 = Sunday, hour 0-23) — replaces every ad group’s schedule

endDay.description: last weekday of the window, 0 = Sunday

startDay.description: first weekday of the window, 0 = Sunday

specialAdCategories.description: HOUSING_EMPLOYMENT_CREDIT for housing, employment or credit ads — Reddit then restricts their targeting. Cannot be changed after creation

spendCapCents.description: lifetime spend ceiling for the whole campaign, in minor units of the ad account’s currency

useCatalog.description: SALES only: true makes it a product-catalog campaign (the new spelling of CATALOG_SALES) — every ad group under it must then use a catalog (create_reddit_ads_ad_group with productSetId + shoppingType; list_reddit_ads_catalogs gives the product set ids, create_reddit_ads_catalog / create_reddit_ads_product_set make them). Frozen once created

viewThroughConversionType.description: CBO only: the conversion attribution window. Cannot be changed later

name: create_reddit_ads_campaign
title: Create a Reddit campaign
